# Matrix Reprogrammed sitewide operational audit — 2026-08-02

## Outcome

The isolated release candidate completes both the sitewide debugging mission and the ordered autonomous-accountability follow-on locally. The final strict public-site audit passes with 1,625 public pages, 73,708 static references, zero hard failures, zero warnings and no public page missing from the Cloudflare asset bundle.

Production was not deployed. The account-owner Cloudflare snapshot records 11,470 Workers build minutes, including 5,470 billable minutes in the current billing period. The zero-overage gate is locked and correctly refuses another Cloudflare build or deployment regardless of the one-deployment-per-day allowance.

## Principal repairs

- Evidence boundaries: all accepted records retain provenance, evidence class and explicit limits. Direct generators can no longer erase required conclusion fields.
- Speculation: anything not fully authenticated is automatically and visibly `SPECULATION`, remains structurally separate and cannot raise factual confidence or support allegations, alerts, conclusions, rewards or guilt by association.
- Unsafe material: secrets, prohibited personal data, prompt injection, malware and unsafe executable content enter security quarantine rather than factual or speculative publication.
- Corrections: corrected or withdrawn evidence propagates across dependent outputs and reopens or downgrades conclusions and reversible rewards.
- Freshness: collection, retrieval, publication and event dates remain separate. Operational build time is never represented as source freshness.
- Navigation and structure: broken anchors and generated routes were repaired; Daily Watch has a visible H1; unavailable generated entity routes are not emitted as links.
- Search: exact, entity, BM25, local-semantic retrieval, source/evidence filters and confidence gating remain local and require no managed-AI provider.
- Membership: active paid members receive billing management rather than a duplicate checkout; PayPal and newsletter requests retain same-origin credentials; marketing consent is explicit and server-validated.
- Entitlement dates: D1 views normalize ISO-8601 grant and subscription timestamps before comparison, including same-day access grants. The corrective migration is repeat-safe.
- Security: admin and control surfaces remain authenticated; SSRF, redirect, sensitive-alias, cost-proof, secret and public-artifact checks fail closed.
- Deployment safety: every direct Cloudflare mutation workflow is manual-only and budget-guarded. Stale usage evidence fails closed and Git-connected deployments remain disabled.

## Current information collection

The network-enabled run fetched 210 records from 7 of 13 configured feeds. The final rebuild reached 0 of 13 feeds and recorded every outage. It preserved 42 dated current-window items; the newest accepted source publication is 2026-08-01T12:00:00.000Z. No synthetic freshness was created and coverage is not described as exhaustive.

The public-market refresh also failed to reach its sources. It preserved 799 verified quantitative rows across eight categories with the prior snapshot date and labelled the result `degraded-preserved-verified-snapshot` rather than claiming a fresh retrieval.

- PR #191 was merged for its strict zero-spend compute/resource broker.

- No other task worktree, branch, service, cache, port, database or artifact was modified.

## Autonomous-accountability follow-on

- A Matrix event bus propagates accepted evidence, corrections and withdrawals to dossiers, entities, relationships, timelines, trackers, conclusions, search, dashboards, alerts, watchlists, sitemaps and machine-readable outputs.
- Member missions, contributions, impact trails, progression and anti-abuse controls use strict D1-backed routes. Member submissions cannot self-authenticate and begin in the speculation lane.
- Human editorial review is not a content fallback. Human action is limited to provider, legal, identity, credential, permission, payment, destructive or consequential external operations.
- Resource and compute providers remain disabled unless explicitly entitled. Remote capacity and the cost ceiling are zero; model replacement requires benchmark, security, provenance, rollback and zero-spend gates.
- Phase 13 creates ten synergy tables, three starter missions and six truthful capability records, and can execute repeatedly.

## Release limits

- Cloudflare production deployment remains blocked by the current billing-period usage snapshot. This is a hard gate.
- Static-browser hosting cannot emulate Cloudflare Worker APIs. API-backed actions are covered by the isolated Worker/D1 suites; public navigation and local search were exercised in the browser.
- The population audit still records three weak legacy pages and 70 intentional artwork/content placeholders. They are routed, bounded and non-blocking, but are not described as complete coverage.
- Source coverage is limited to configured and reachable public/authoritative sources; six feeds failed during the network-enabled run and all 13 failed during the final rebuild.
